name: Moodboard
prompt: Premium commercial game UI concept for an original modern Korean urban life simulation called Ian Growing. Modern dense pixel art, tired ordinary protagonist, dry humor about work, education, debt, investing. Practical civic design, charcoal ink, muted blue-grey, warm uncoated paper, desaturated jade and selective oxblood seal. Group related data, stepped pixel edges, aligned numerals, restrained ink rules, explicit focus states, readable Korean. Show one finished straight-on game frame. No logos, generic mobile decoration, excessive frames, fantasy or web dashboard. Create an art direction board for a Korean municipal life record / everyday commuter pass interface. Use the supplied original game world, its character, apartment, city and office. Place original inventory, finance, gacha and receipt motifs around quiet world vignettes; small stamped and perforated paper details. No readable filler copy.
